name: HW-201 IR Proximity / Lid Detector
description: Infrared obstacle detection module with adjustable range (2–30 cm). Digital output goes LOW when object is detected. Used for lid-open detection, bin overflow alerts, and object presence.

signals.name: object_detected
signals.description: true when object is within detection range (active LOW hardware — inverted in firmware)

firmwareHint: Hardware output is active-LOW. Invert in firmware: detected = (digitalRead(pin) == LOW). Use INPUT_PULLUP if floating issues occur.
